title: WEMIX Hit With $724K Stablecoin Security Breach
snippet: WEMIX says it has become the latest digital asset platform to suffer a security breach. The blockchain network announced Sunday (July 26) that an attacker had compromised ownership of its WEMIX$ stablecoin, converting it into 30,736 WEMIX and $724,198.27 in USDC stablecoins.
